_comment: Lectern's filter. A posting is KEPT if any role_title word appears in its title, or if three or more topic_text words appear in its body. flex_text never causes a keep — it only annotates a kept record, because 'part-time' on its own has nothing to do with teaching. Every kept record records which words matched and where, so a reader can apply this file by hand to one posting and get the same answer.

ignore_words_by_company._comment: Words that appear in (nearly) every posting on that board — company boilerplate, not a signal. Measured, not guessed. Writer, 2026-09-19: these three appeared in 51 of 51 postings and alone pushed every job over the line.
